newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on retail buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended up by more than 3.0 percent on buying by small and institutional investors, brokers said.
"The market was active amid fresh commitments by both retail and institutional investors. And the market quickly recovered from losses in the previous session," said one broker.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 39.18 points or 3.29 percent at 1,227.02 on turnover of 81 million. Gainers led losers by 103 to 28. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
Bangladesh Thai Aluminium gained 75 taka to 842, Apex Foods rose 111 to 2,418 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 2.0 to 170.
